method.source: CFTC Disaggregated Commitments of Traders, futures only, all contract months.
method.entry: Forward returns start at the first session close after CFTC published, using each week's real publication date. Federal holidays delay the release, and roughly one week in seven is not a Friday.
method.price: Front-month continuous futures with the roll steps removed. The return across each front-month change is dropped rather than counted, so an old-crop-to-new-crop roll is not read as a rally.
method.overlap: Weekly sampling of multi-week returns overlaps. Each read shows spells as well as weeks: matches closer together than the horizon count once.
method.significance: Circular block bootstrap, block length twice the horizon, 20,000 draws.
method.multiplicity: 56 tests produced a p-value this week out of 96 attempted. At p<0.05 you would expect 2.8 to look significant by chance. 1 did. 0 survive a Benjamini-Yekutieli false-discovery control across the family.
method.conditions: Each condition is anchored on this week's reading, so the question is always 'weeks that looked like this one'. That means the threshold moves every week; the correction below covers one week's family, not the sequence of weeks a regular reader sees.
method.gates: A read is withheld below 30 comparable weeks, below the horizon's spell count, or above 28% of the record.
